youtube_description:
Kami berkesempatan untuk melakukan interview dengan Maxie Esho (CLS Knights) setelah scrimmage game 2 antara CLS Knights melawan Wesports Malaysia Dragons. Dalam pertandingan ini Esho berhasil mencetak 15 poin untuk kemenangan CLS Knights.

Watch the highlights:
CLS vs WMD Game 1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S3XoSJtwQMw&index=3&list=PLeDI51GP7qQWY12D9GUe1YjVLnkUolOZX&t=0s
CLS vs WMD Game 2: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e_u9-_rhgIY&list=PLeDI51GP7qQWY12D9GUe1YjVLnkUolOZX&index=4&t=4s

Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/idnhoops/

If you like the video, don't forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe. Thank you for watching and always #SupportLocalHoops !
